Hooks & operators

Five silent guards. Two commands you type. Extras when you want them.
Hooks — run silently
session-start.py — injects handoff + memory stats, checks 3 caps + stale refs
pre-compact.sh — blocks compaction until memory saved and under cap
periodic-save.sh — save prompt every ~50 messages
protect-tests.sh — guards test files
session-end.sh — timestamps the close
Operators — you type them
/close-session
audit · promote · handoff
/tour
guided walkthrough
.kit/advanced/ — opt-in
/memory-usage · /memory-lint · /memory-query · daily-journal layer (/close-day)
Plain text files only. No databases. git checkout restores anything.
